messages:
priya: quick preflight 1: tenant routing pilot scheduled for Weds. need final scope decisions by EOD. Customer A is asking for SAML + per-tenant hard quotas. what can we realistically promise for MVP?
sam: perf note: embedding cache + per-tenant sharding increases p95 ~40ms in bench. hard quotas need extra enforcement paths. can we ship UI-only quotas for MVP?
leila: ops POV: UI-only quota + natty messaging is low-risk. we can surface quotas in console and log quota hits, enforce in v1.
jordan: just talked to Customer A1 — SAML is "must-have" for full rollout but they're open to pilot without it if we provide a clear v1 timeline and migration path.
mike: security: SAML touches KMS onboarding + docs for private installs. risky for pilot. recommend defer SAML to v1. must do tenant isolation review before pilot.
priya: proposal: MVP = tenant routing + emb-cache (conservative TTL) + UI-only quotas. Defer hard quota enforcement and SAML to v1. we add a migration note for customers. thoughts?
sam: ok on deferring hard quotas. emb-cache will ship with `--emb-cache-mode=conservative` and a runtime purge endpoint. also add a kill-switch flag.
alex: can we list acceptance criteria so sales has something to sign? simple bullets please.
leila: acceptance criteria draft: 1) tenant routing supports 50 active tenants concurrently; 2) p95 <= 300ms under pilot load; 3) quota UI present and logs quota events; 4) audit logs enabled for tenant ops; 5) documented fallback for emb-cache degradation.
jordan: Customer A will accept pilot if we commit to SAML + hard quotas in v1 + migration plan. i'll put that in the pilot contract.
sam: ops request: run a 24h canary where 10% traffic goes to dedicated pool, auto-fallback to hosted if errors or latency > threshold. flag: `canary:start --route tenant-pilot --pct 10`.
priya: add canary + auto-fallback to acceptance criteria. also require a regression test for tenant isolation.
mike: i'll run a quick threat model and confirm no secrets can leak between tenants. expect signoff by EOD.
alex: timeline impact: with these cuts we keep Weds. if security or canary job isn't green by EOD, slide to next Tue.
leila: ops checklist: smoke tests, canary runbook, dashboards, runbook update. i'll own runbooks and dashboards.
priya: final call: cutlist = defer SAML, defer hard enforcement of quotas, ship emb-cache conservative, UI-only quotas, add canary route and auto-fallback. accept?
jordan: +1 from CS.
sam: +1 eng.
mike: +1 sec (pending threat-model doc).
alex: i'll update roadmap and email sales + solutions.
deploy-bot: reminder — canary requires job. run: `canary:start --route tenant-pilot --percent 10`
